title: Task 1.1: Replying to Sarah about Social Media Habits

body.answer: There are two suggestions that I would like to make for rehearsing: practice out loud in front of a mirror with a timer, and rehearse once with a friend.

body.frame: G. Provide Instruction / Suggestion: There are two suggestions that I would like to make.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion in an essay to an educated reader. Include specific reasons and relevant examples from your knowledge or experience to support your answer.
